text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on February 15, 2023. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Tory to recognize Michael D'Andrea, Chief Engineer and Executive Director, Engineering and Construction Services on his retirement from the City. Mayor Tory commended Michael D'Andrea on his contribution as outstanding leader in the public service spanning over 35 years. Mayor Tory commented that Michael is a true professional in every sense of the word, and described him as steady, capable, decent, honest, firm, and public-spirited. Mayor Tory acknowledged that Mr. D'Andrea and his team of 650 professionals and technical staff in recent years are collectively responsible for delivering one billion dollars in municipal capital projects on time.
